verdict.label: Full review
verdict.summary: You must create a Spotify developer app, configure your redirect URI, and request quota extension for production users.

composioFit.summary: Spotify is not a Composio-managed app, so you must bring your own OAuth app configuration.
whyOwnApp: Composio does not manage a default OAuth app for Spotify.
You need custom control over your client credentials and scopes.

phases.name: Create Spotify App
steps: Go to your Spotify Developer Dashboard.
Click on the Create an App button.
Fill in app details and accept Developer Terms of Service.
phases.handoff: Copy your Client ID and Client Secret into the Composio dashboard.

phases.name: Configure Redirect URI
steps: Copy the redirect URI provided by the Composio dashboard.
Add it to your Spotify app's Redirect URIs allowlist.
phases.handoff: Save changes in the Spotify Developer Dashboard.

phases.name: Development Testing
steps: Use development mode to test with up to 5 authenticated users.
Add users via the Users Management tab if needed.
phases.handoff: Proceed to quota extension when ready for production users.

phases.name: Quota Extension Review
steps: Submit the Quota extension Request tab.
Wait for Spotify's app review team to evaluate compliance.
phases.handoff: App is moved into extended quota mode once approved.

artefacts.title: Spotify App Registration Values
artefacts.body:
App Name: AI Agent Integration
App Description: Connects your Spotify account to an AI assistant.
Website: https://example.com
Redirect URI: <Composio callback URL from your auth config>

artefacts.title: Scope Justification
artefacts.body: We request user-read-private, user-read-email, and playlist-read-private to let users view their profile and manage playlists via our AI agent.

requirements.label: Privacy Policy
requirements.when: Always required for developer apps handling user data

requirements.label: Extended Quota / Partner Application
requirements.when: Required when moving out of development mode for more users

redirectRules.rule: The value of redirect_uri here must exactly match one of the values you entered when you registered your application, including upper or lowercase, terminating slashes, and such.
Use HTTPS for your redirect URI, unless you are using a loopback address, when HTTP is permitted.
localhost is not allowed as redirect URI.

blockers.cause: The client ID provided in the authorization request does not exist or is malformed.
blockers.fix: Check your Client ID in the Spotify dashboard and ensure it is copied correctly.

blockers.cause: Your app is in development mode and has exceeded request limits or user caps.
blockers.fix: Request a quota extension via the Spotify Developer Dashboard.
blockers.fallback: Limit testing volume to stay within development thresholds.

blockers.symptom: Redirect URI mismatch error during authorization
blockers.cause: The redirect URI sent in the request does not exactly match the allowlisted redirect URI.
blockers.fix: Ensure exact matching including protocols, slashes, and casing.
blockers.fallback: Update the allowlisted redirect URIs in the dashboard.

checklist.text: Log in to the Spotify Developer Dashboard and click Create an App.
Agree to the Developer Terms of Service and create the app.
Copy the Client ID and Client Secret.
Get the redirect URI from your Composio auth config.
Add the redirect URI to your Spotify app settings.
Paste Client ID and Client Secret into the Composio dashboard.
Test OAuth flow with your own account in development mode.
Submit a quota extension request when ready for public users.

uncertainties: Exact review turnaround time in business days is not explicitly documented by Spotify.
Specific rate limit numbers for development vs extended mode are not detailed in the source snippets.
